how_to_apply: Visit the Careers Portal of the University at careers.amuonline.ac.in.
Fill out the Application Form in the Online Mode.
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- online (PwD candidates are exempted upon uploading an authentic Disability Certificate).
Take a printout of the PDF file of the Application Form on A-4 Size paper after successful submission.
Append your signature and paste a front-facing recent photograph at the designated place on the Application Form.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents and certificates.

Super-scribe on the top-left side of the cover the post applied for, advertisement number and its date, and submit or send the Application Form to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 on or before 21.10.2026 (04:00 P.M.).

content_sections.heading: AMU Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 6 vacancies distributed across three departments in the Faculty of Medicine.

content_sections.heading: AMU Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Indian nationals (including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955) are eligible to apply.

rows.qualification_required: As per NMC norms / Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU.

content_sections.heading: AMU Salary
content_sections.text: Appointments will be made on a purely temporary basis subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.

content_sections.heading: AMU Application Fee
content_sections.text: The non-refundable Processing Fee is to be paid only in the Online Mode at the Careers Portal.

rows.fee: Exempted (provided they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a Local Selection Committee interview held in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh. Candidates are required to report with all original documents in the office of the Dean half an hour before the scheduled time of the L.S.C. Candidates who will apply for the post of Assistant Professor are required to bring 01 presentation on the topic of their area of interest on their concerned subject in soft copy (pen drive) for presentation at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: High School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and degree of Post-Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M. Phil/Ph.D. Degree wherever applicable Experience Certificates wherever applicable Valid Registration of Graduation and Post graduation from NMC Internship completion certificate Other testimonial(s) No Objection Certificate, if employed from the present employer/relieving orders of all previous employers Disability Certificate on prescribed proforma (Appendix-1) for PwD candidates, if applicable

faq.question: Q1. What is AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AMU Recruitment 2026 refers to the temporary recruitment notification issued by the Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, for 6 Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts under Advertisement No. FM/37/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are available: 1 for Assistant Professor in E.N.T., 2 for Assistant Professor in Psychiatry, and 3 for Senior Resident in Medicine.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 13 October 2026 up to 11:59 PM, and the last date for receipt of hard copies of the application form is 21 October 2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AMU Assistant Professor and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per NMC norms and the residency scheme adopted by AMU, along with valid registration from NMC and requisite degrees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The non-refundable processing fee is Rs. 500/- for all other applicants, while PwD candidates are exempted from the fee upon uploading an authentic disability certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for AMU Faculty of Medicine posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online via the careers portal at careers.amuonline.ac.in, pay the fee online, print the application form, attach self-attested documents, and send the hard copy by post or submit it to the Office of the Dean, J.N. Medical College, AMU.

faq.question: Q7. When will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee interviews will be held on 31 October 2026 starting at 12:30 PM, 01:00 PM, and 01:30 PM respectively depending on the department, in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine.

faq.question: Q8. Will separate interview letters be issued to candidates?
faq.answer: No separate Notice or Interview letter will be issued to candidates; applicants must report directly on 31 October 2026 as per the published schedule.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for AMU Assistant Professor and Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: Assistant Professors are placed at Pay Level AL-10, and Senior Residents are placed at Pay Level AL-11.

faq.question: Q10. Is the appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, appointments will be made on a purely temporary basis subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.
